files.description: Bike-share riders, one per row (400 rows): rider_id (six-digit id with leading zeros), display_name (person name, some with accented letters), home_district (one of 6 districts such as "Old Town"), membership (casual, monthly or annual) - these three text columns have inconsistent capital letters and stray spaces; joined_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD; about 2% empty), birth_year (whole number; about 4% empty), credit_balance (two decimals, can be negative; about 5% empty).

task_text: In riders.csv, clean membership by trimming and lower-casing, then upgrade every monthly rider whose joined_on is before 2023-01-01 to annual; riders with an empty joined_on are not changed. `result` should be a Series counting riders per membership level after the upgrade, indexed by level in alphabetical order.
intended_computation: Read riders.csv; clean membership (strip, lower case); riders with level monthly and a joined_on before 2023-01-01 become annual (empty joined_on unchanged); a Series counting riders per level, indexed by level in alphabetical order.

acceptable_variants.notes: counts may be a one-column table
